fields.description: Issue features commentary urging Miami businesses and residents to welcome visiting Shriners ethically and avoid price-gouging and scams. Reports and satire cover the ongoing trial of Chief of Police Quigg and other officers, local political campaigning and speeches (including Sidney J. Catts and Jim Carson), and concerns about bootleg and adulterated liquor during convention week. Includes local civic and infrastructure notes (Miami River conditions, courthouse, streets), election and candidate notices, and entertainment/sports listings including boxing and theater; mentions the Tamiami Trail opening and Miami City Club activities.
